description: This file defines the SugarFieldInt class, which extends SugarFieldBase, and provides methods for formatting, unformatting, and searching integer fields in the SuiteCRM application. It handles display formatting, data sanitization, and search query preparation for integer fields within the CRM.

classes.name: SugarFieldInt
classes.description: Handles display, search, and import processing for integer fields within SuiteCRM. Provides methods for formatting, unformatting, and sanitizing integer data, as well as generating search view templates.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Formats raw integer data for display, with optional disabling of number formatting based on vardef settings.

methods.name: unformatField
methods.description: Converts formatted field input back into an integer value.

methods.name: getSearchWhereValue
methods.description: Processes search input to produce a valid integer or handle multiple values, returning -1 for invalid entries.

methods.name: unformatSearchRequest
methods.description: Unformats the search request data for processing.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty template for search view, supporting range search if applicable.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates input data during import to ensure it is a valid number.
